title: The range: DoD testing playground in the California desert

tellings.quote: Uh the range was a giant playground for Department of Defense and its private aerospace partners for testing weapons technology,

plain: Around 2001, a range in the California desert served as "a giant playground" for the Department of Defense and its private aerospace partners to test weapons technology. Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot, describes it from his own time working there. He brings it up to set the scene for the secret work he says he was later part of.
